INDEPENDENT · UNOFFICIAL FIELD GUIDE

Azeroth Survivors damage meter

Last updated: October 29, 2026

Field guide

What is Azeroth Survivors?How to playBuildsTier listDownload & fixesSafety checkTalent treeLuck

The browser build does not ship a built-in DPS meter. Players who want per-run damage breakdowns use external overlays or community HUDs, and the search demand for "custom HUD" is real — but there is no developer-distributed HUD package. Anything that asks you to load an external script or replace a game file is running outside the official entry point.

If you only need to compare your own runs, the in-game armory and talent screens already show what changed between attempts. Use those before adding a third-party overlay.

What to use instead

  • Review the in-game Armory after each attempt.
  • Check Talents to identify progression changes.
  • Record your carry ranks and run outcome when comparing attempts.

Risk note

We do not host HUD files or provide HUD downloads. An external script or replacement game file is outside the official entry point.
